info.name: GlobeTrotter Backend
info.description: Validates every GlobeTrotter microservice individually (direct ports, requires docker-compose.override.yml), then the full workflow through the API Gateway only -- exactly what the Next.js frontend will call. See POSTMAN_CHECKLIST.md at the repo root for the step-by-step guide.

item.name: 00 - Health Checks
item.description: Run this first. Every service (and the gateway's own aggregate check) should respond 200. If any is down, fix that before moving on -- everything downstream depends on it.

item.name: 01 - Auth Service (direct :5001)

request.description: Registers a fresh visitor account (username is timestamped so this is safe to re-run).

Uses the constant admin credentials from .env (ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD).

item.name: 07 - API Gateway - Full E2E Workflow

request.description: Proves the gateway correctly routes /api/users/* to the User Service, and that the Auth -> User Service internal registration call worked end-to-end.

item.name: Admin - Create Destination (via Gateway -> Destination Service)

request.description: Proves /api/admin/destinations is routed to the Destination Service, not swallowed by the more general /api/admin prefix (which goes to the Admin Service) -- this is the longest-prefix-wins routing rule in api-gateway/config.py.

item.description: Run 00-06 at least once first so seed/admin state exists, then run this folder top-to-bottom through the GATEWAY ONLY (port 5000) -- this is exactly the path the Next.js frontend will take once reconnected. If every request here passes, the frontend is safe to point at the gateway.

item.name: 08 - Cleanup (run manually)
item.description: Destructive -- not part of the automated run. Removes the test destinations and profile created above. Note: this only deletes the User Service profile, not the Auth Service credential record (Auth Service has no delete-user endpoint yet -- see the root README's 'out of scope' section).
